scenarios.title: Server status
scenarios.purpose: Uptime, disks, services and network of a production server.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.9 -Y 0.05 -Radius 0.55 -Color $glow
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.05 -Y 1 -Radius 0.5 -Color $glow
    )

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'PRODUCTION  ·  SQL SERVER 2022' -Color $accent `
        -FontSize 15 -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'SQL-PROD-01' -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 72 `
        -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name '●  1 warning · D: Data is 88 % full' `
        -Color $warn -FontSize 17 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Role' -Value 'Primary replica · AG-FINANCE'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Owner' -Value 'Data Platform team'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Maintenance' -Value 'Sunday 02:00–04:00 UTC'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'On call' -Value 'dba-oncall@contoso.com'

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas @canvas -Tile $tiles -RightTileWidth 440

    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'volumes' -Title 'Volumes used' `
        -Kind ProgressBar -Values @($volumes.Values) `
        -Labels @($volumes.Keys) -Palette $ok, $warn, $ok -Maximum 100 `
        -ValueSuffix ' %' -NoProgressHandles -ShowLatestValue:$false `

        -Maximum 12 -ShowDataLabels -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -Anchor BottomRight -OffsetX $hud.MarginX
} @text -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "server-status-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
scenarios.source:
<#
    Server status wallpaper: who the server is, how long it has been up,
    and whether disks, services and the network need attention.

    Sample values keep the render reproducible. Each one notes the command
    that supplies it on a real server.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Dark',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force
$hudTheme = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Showcase\HudTheme.ps1'
$hud = & $hudTheme -Theme $Theme -Width $Width -Height $Height
$dark = $Theme -eq 'Dark'
$ok, $warn, $bad = $hud.Status.Ok, $hud.Status.Warn, $hud.Status.Bad
$accent = if ($dark) { '#2DD4BF' } else { '#0D9488' }

# (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
$uptime = New-TimeSpan -Days 41 -Hours 6

# Get-Volume | Where-Object DriveLetter
$volumes = [ordered]@{ 'C: System' = 61; 'D: Data' = 88; 'L: Logs' = 47 }

# Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'
$cpu = 12, 28, 19, 44, 31, 38, 27, 23

# Get-Counter '\Network Interface(*)\Bytes Total/sec'
$network = 180, 210, 260, 240, 310, 420, 380, 350, 300, 312

$background = @{
    Width          = $Width
    Height         = $Height
    Color          = if ($dark) { '#04101A' } else { '#EAF4F4' }
    Gradient       = if ($dark) { '#062A33', '#050A14' } else {
        '#F7FBFB', '#DCEBEF'
    }
    Pattern        = 'Grid'
    PatternColor   = if ($dark) { '#FFFFFF0A' } else { '#0F172A0D' }
    PatternSpacing = 64
}
$glow = if ($dark) { '#14B8A655' } else { '#5EEAD480' }

$tile = @{ Side = 'Right'; SurfaceStyle = 'Glass' }
$tiles = @(
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Terminal -Label 'UPTIME' `
        -Value "$($uptime.Days) days $($uptime.Hours) h" `
        -Detail 'Since the September patch window' -Accent $ok
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Cpu -Label 'CPU' `
        -Value "$($cpu[-1]) %" -Detail '16 cores · 2.9 GHz' `
        -Accent $accent -MiniChartKind Area -MiniChartValues $cpu `
        -MiniChartMaximum 100
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Memory -Label 'MEMORY' `
        -Value '100 of 128 GB' -Detail 'SQL Server buffer pool' `
        -Progress 0.78 -Accent $warn
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Network -Label 'NETWORK' `
        -Value "$($network[-1]) Mbps" -Detail '10.40.12.21 · 10 GbE' `
        -Accent $accent -MiniChartKind Sparkline -MiniChartValues $network
)

$text = $hud.Text
$canvas = $hud.Canvas
$panel = $hud.Panel
# Three equal panels share the bottom row with 24 px gutters.
$third = [int](($Width - 2 * $hud.MarginX - 48) / 3)
$bottom = @{ Width = $third; Height = 300; OffsetY = $hud.MarginY }

New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.9 -Y 0.05 -Radius 0.55 -Color $glow
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.05 -Y 1 -Radius 0.5 -Color $glow
    )

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'PRODUCTION  ·  SQL SERVER 2022' -Color $accent `
        -FontSize 15 -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'SQL-PROD-01' -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 72 `
        -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name '●  1 warning · D: Data is 88 % full' `
        -Color $warn -FontSize 17 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Role' -Value 'Primary replica · AG-FINANCE'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Owner' -Value 'Data Platform team'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Maintenance' -Value 'Sunday 02:00–04:00 UTC'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'On call' -Value 'dba-oncall@contoso.com'

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas @canvas -Tile $tiles -RightTileWidth 440

    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'volumes' -Title 'Volumes used' `
        -Kind ProgressBar -Values @($volumes.Values) `
        -Labels @($volumes.Keys) -Palette $ok, $warn, $ok -Maximum 100 `
        -ValueSuffix ' %' -NoProgressHandles -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -Anchor BottomLeft -OffsetX $hud.MarginX
    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'network' -Title 'Network' `
        -Kind Area -Values $network -LineColor $accent -ShowGrid `
        -GridLineCount 4 -ValueSuffix ' Mbps' `
        -Anchor BottomCenter -OffsetX 0
    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'services' -Title 'Critical services' `
        -Kind Pictorial -Values 11, 1 -Labels 'Running', 'Stopped' `
        -Palette $ok, $bad -PictorialSymbol Circle -PictorialColumns 12 `
        -Maximum 12 -ShowDataLabels -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -Anchor BottomRight -OffsetX $hud.MarginX
} @text -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "server-status-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"

scenarios.title: Help desk
scenarios.purpose: How to get help, plus the details support asks for.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0 -Y 0 -Radius 0.6 -Color $glows[0]
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.75 -Y 1.05 -Radius 0.55 -Color $glows[1]
    )

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'IT SERVICE DESK' -Color $accent -FontSize 16 `
        -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Need help?' -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 88 `
        -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Call 555-0100, extension 4357' `
        -Color $accent -FontSize 40 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Have the asset tag on the right ready.' `
        -Color $hud.Muted -FontSize 22
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Portal' -Value 'help.contoso.com'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Teams' -Value '#it-help'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Walk-in' -Value 'Building B, room 012'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Hours' -Value 'Monday–Friday, 07:00–19:00'

    # Health from your monitoring or status page API.

        -FontWeight 700

scenarios.source:
<#
    Help-desk wallpaper for shared or front-desk PCs. It tells people how
    to get help and shows the details the service desk asks for first.

    Sample values keep the render reproducible. Each one notes the command
    that supplies it on a real machine.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Light',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force
$hudTheme = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Showcase\HudTheme.ps1'
$hud = & $hudTheme -Theme $Theme -Width $Width -Height $Height
$dark = $Theme -eq 'Dark'
$ok, $warn = $hud.Status.Ok, $hud.Status.Warn
$accent = if ($dark) { '#A78BFA' } else { '#7C3AED' }

$background = @{
    Width    = $Width
    Height   = $Height
    Color    = if ($dark) { '#0E0A1A' } else { '#FBF7FF' }
    Gradient = if ($dark) { '#1E1438', '#0A0712' } else {
        '#FFFFFF', '#F1E9FF'
    }
    GradientAngle = 160
    Pattern  = 'Dots'
    PatternColor = if ($dark) { '#FFFFFF12' } else { '#4C1D9512' }
    PatternSpacing = 36
}
$glows = if ($dark) { '#7C3AED55', '#EC489940' } else {
    '#C4B5FD99', '#FBCFE899'
}

$tile = @{ Side = 'Right'; SurfaceStyle = 'Glass'; Accent = $accent }
$tiles = @(
    # Asset tags usually come from the BIOS:
    # (Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemEnclosure).SMBIOSAssetTag
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Shield -Label 'ASSET TAG' `
        -Value 'CT-04217' -Detail 'Sticker under the keyboard'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Computer `
        -Label 'COMPUTER NAME' -Value 'FRONTDESK-07' -Detail 'Reception, B1'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Network -Label 'IP ADDRESS' `
        -Value '10.20.4.37' -Detail 'Wired · VLAN 120'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind User -Label 'SIGNED IN AS' `
        -Value 'Reception (shared)' -Detail 'Resets at sign-out'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind OperatingSystem `
        -Label 'WINDOWS' -Value '11 Enterprise 24H2' -Detail 'Build 26100'
)

$text = $hud.Text
$canvas = $hud.Canvas.Clone()
# Center the tile column beside the vertically centered text.
$step = $canvas.TileHeight + $canvas.TileGap
$column = $tiles.Count * $step - $canvas.TileGap
$canvas.RightTileOffsetY += ($Height - $column) / 2 - $hud.MarginY

New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0 -Y 0 -Radius 0.6 -Color $glows[0]
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.75 -Y 1.05 -Radius 0.55 -Color $glows[1]
    )

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'IT SERVICE DESK' -Color $accent -FontSize 16 `
        -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Need help?' -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 88 `
        -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Call 555-0100, extension 4357' `
        -Color $accent -FontSize 40 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'Have the asset tag on the right ready.' `
        -Color $hud.Muted -FontSize 22
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Portal' -Value 'help.contoso.com'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Teams' -Value '#it-help'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Walk-in' -Value 'Building B, room 012'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Hours' -Value 'Monday–Friday, 07:00–19:00'

    # Health from your monitoring or status page API.
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name ' ' -FontSize 12
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'SERVICE STATUS' -Color $accent -FontSize 16 `
        -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name '●  Email, Teams, Wi-Fi and VPN are working' `
        -Color $ok -FontSize 19 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name '●  Floor 2 printers are offline until 14:00' `
        -Color $warn -FontSize 19 -FontWeight 600

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas @canvas -Tile $tiles -RightTileWidth 460
} @text -TextPosition MiddleLeft `
    -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "helpdesk-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"

scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.1 -Y 0.1 -Radius 0.5 -Color $glows[0]

scenarios.title: Admin workstation
scenarios.purpose: Dense privileged-access HUD with the allowed admin path.
scenarios.excerpt:
New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.65 -Y 0.25 -Radius 0.6 -Color $glows[0]
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 1 -Y 0 -Radius 0.3 -Color $glows[1]
    )

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'TIER 0  ·  PRIVILEGED ACCESS WORKSTATION' `
        -Color $bad -FontSize 15 -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'PAW-T0-03' -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 64 `
        -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'No email, no browsing, no personal accounts.' `
        -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 19 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Operator' -Value 'adm.jsmith'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Domain' -Value 'corp.contoso.com'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Reachable' -Value 'Jump host → tier 0 only'

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas @canvas -Tile $tiles -LeftTileWidth 460

    # Last 7 days from the Security log, event 4672.
    New-BGInfoChart @panel -Id 'signins' -Title 'Privileged sign-ins' `
        -Kind Bar -Values 4, 6, 3, 9, 5, 2, 7 -LineColor $accent `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' today' `
        -Width 560 -Height 270 -Anchor TopRight `
        -OffsetX $hud.MarginX -OffsetY $hud.MarginY

    $diagram = $hud.Diagram
    New-BGInfoTopology @diagram -Title 'Allowed admin path' `
        -Subtitle '2 hops to tier 0' -Layout DenseGrouped -Scale $diagramScale `
        -NodeDisplayMode Card -Width $column -Height $diagramHeight `
        -Anchor TopRight -OffsetX $hud.MarginX -OffsetY $diagramTop `
        -TopologyDefinition {
        $node = @{ Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'paw' -Label 'This workstation'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'jump' -Label 'Jump hosts'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 't0' -Label 'Tier 0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'paw' -Label 'PAW-T0-03' `
            -Subtitle 'Windows 11' -Kind Endpoint -GroupId 'paw'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'jmp' -Label 'JMP-T0-01' `
            -Subtitle 'Server 2025' -Kind Gateway -GroupId 'jump'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'dc1' -Label 'DC01' `
            -Subtitle 'PDC emulator' -Kind Server -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'ca' -Label 'CA01' `
            -Subtitle 'Enterprise CA' -Kind Certificate -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode -Id 'dc2' -Label 'DC02' -Subtitle 'Replica' `
            -Kind Server -GroupId 't0' -Status Warning
        $link = @{ Kind = 'Connectivity'; Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'paw' -TargetNodeId 'jmp' `
            -Label 'RDP + MFA' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'dc1' `
            -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'ca' `
            -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge -SourceNodeId 'dc1' -TargetNodeId 'dc2' `
            -Label '14 min lag' -Kind Replication -Status Warning
    }
    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'changes' -Title 'Tier 0 changes' `
        -Kind Area -Values 2, 1, 4, 3, 8, 5, 3, 2, 6, 4 -LineColor $accent `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' this hour' `
        -OffsetX ($hud.MarginX + $half + 24) -OffsetY $hud.MarginY
    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'alerts' -Title 'Open security alerts' `
        -Kind ProgressBar -Values 1, 3, 6 -Labels 'High', 'Medium', 'Low' `
        -Palette $bad, $warn, $accent -Maximum 10 -NoProgressHandles `
        -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -OffsetX $hud.MarginX -OffsetY $hud.MarginY
} @text -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "admin-workstation-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
scenarios.source:
<#
    Privileged access workstation. A dense, dark HUD for administrators:
    health tiles with recent trends, the tier 0 path this machine is allowed
    to reach, and the privileged activity worth a second look.

    Sample values keep the render reproducible. Comments name the command
    or source that supplies each value in a real environment.
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('Light', 'Dark')]
    [string] $Theme = 'Dark',
    [int] $Width = 1920,
    [int] $Height = 1080,
    [string] $OutputDirectory = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Output')
)

Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\PowerBGInfo.psd1') -Force
$hudTheme = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Showcase\HudTheme.ps1'
$hud = & $hudTheme -Theme $Theme -Width $Width -Height $Height
$dark = $Theme -eq 'Dark'
$ok, $warn, $bad = $hud.Status.Ok, $hud.Status.Warn, $hud.Status.Bad
$accent = if ($dark) { '#818CF8' } else { '#4F46E5' }

$background = @{
    Width          = $Width
    Height         = $Height
    Color          = if ($dark) { '#05060B' } else { '#F3F4F8' }
    Gradient       = if ($dark) { '#0D1020', '#05060B' } else {
        '#FAFAFD', '#E4E7F1'
    }
    GradientAngle  = 100
    Pattern        = 'Grid'
    PatternColor   = if ($dark) { '#FFFFFF08' } else { '#1E1B4B0C' }
    PatternSpacing = 32
}
$glows = if ($dark) { '#4F46E544', '#DC262622' } else {
    '#A5B4FC80', '#FCA5A555'
}

# Seven tiles fill the left rail from the top margin to the bottom margin.
$canvas = $hud.Canvas.Clone()
$rail = $Height - 2 * $hud.MarginY - 6 * $canvas.TileGap
$canvas.TileHeight = [Math]::Floor($rail / 7)
$tile = @{ Side = 'Left'; SurfaceStyle = 'Glass'; Accent = $accent }
$tiles = @(
    # Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Cpu -Label 'CPU' `
        -Value '18 %' -Detail '8 cores · Credential Guard on' `
        -MiniChartKind Area -MiniChartValues 9, 14, 31, 22, 12, 18 `
        -MiniChartMaximum 100
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Memory -Label 'MEMORY' `
        -Value '9.6 of 32 GB' -Detail 'Hyper-V isolation' `
        -MiniChartKind Bars -MiniChartValues 28, 30, 29, 31, 30, 30 `
        -MiniChartMaximum 100
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Storage -Label 'SYSTEM DRIVE' `
        -Value '212 GB free' -Detail 'BitLocker · TPM + PIN' `
        -Progress 0.41
    # Get-MpComputerStatus
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Shield -Label 'DEFENDER' `
        -Value 'Protected' -Detail 'Signatures 2 h old' -Accent $ok
    # Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn | Select-Object -Last 1
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind OperatingSystem `
        -Label 'PATCH LEVEL' -Value 'October 2026' -Detail 'Ring 0 · pilot' `
        -Accent $ok
    # Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My | Sort-Object NotAfter
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Domain -Label 'SMART CARD' `
        -Value 'Expires in 27 days' -Detail 'Renew before 11 Nov' `
        -Accent $warn
    New-BGInfoVisualCanvasTile @tile -IconKind Terminal -Label 'ELEVATION' `
        -Value 'JIT until 16:40' -Detail 'Approved by S. Ortiz' `
        -Accent $warn
)

$text = $hud.Text.Clone()
$text.SpaceX = 2 * $hud.MarginX + 460
$panel = $hud.Panel

# The content column runs from the text block to the right margin.
$column = $Width - $text.SpaceX - $hud.MarginX
$half = ($column - 24) / 2
$bottom = @{ Anchor = 'BottomRight'; Width = $half; Height = 210 }
# The diagram fills the space between the top row and the bottom row.
$diagramTop = 360
$diagramHeight = $Height - $diagramTop - $hud.MarginY - 210 - 32
# Render nodes and labels twice as large on 1440p and bigger screens.
$diagramScale = if ($Height -ge 1440) { 2 } else { 1 }

New-BGInfo -Target File {
    New-BGInfoBackground @background -Glow @(
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 0.65 -Y 0.25 -Radius 0.6 -Color $glows[0]
        New-BGInfoBackgroundGlow -X 1 -Y 0 -Radius 0.3 -Color $glows[1]
    )

    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'TIER 0  ·  PRIVILEGED ACCESS WORKSTATION' `
        -Color $bad -FontSize 15 -FontWeight 700
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'PAW-T0-03' -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 64 `
        -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoLabel -Name 'No email, no browsing, no personal accounts.' `
        -Color $hud.Ink -FontSize 19 -FontWeight 600
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Operator' -Value 'adm.jsmith'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Domain' -Value 'corp.contoso.com'
    New-BGInfoValue -Name 'Reachable' -Value 'Jump host → tier 0 only'

    New-BGInfoVisualCanvas @canvas -Tile $tiles -LeftTileWidth 460

    # Last 7 days from the Security log, event 4672.
    New-BGInfoChart @panel -Id 'signins' -Title 'Privileged sign-ins' `
        -Kind Bar -Values 4, 6, 3, 9, 5, 2, 7 -LineColor $accent `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' today' `
        -Width 560 -Height 270 -Anchor TopRight `
        -OffsetX $hud.MarginX -OffsetY $hud.MarginY

    $diagram = $hud.Diagram
    New-BGInfoTopology @diagram -Title 'Allowed admin path' `
        -Subtitle '2 hops to tier 0' -Layout DenseGrouped -Scale $diagramScale `
        -NodeDisplayMode Card -Width $column -Height $diagramHeight `
        -Anchor TopRight -OffsetX $hud.MarginX -OffsetY $diagramTop `
        -TopologyDefinition {
        $node = @{ Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'paw' -Label 'This workstation'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 'jump' -Label 'Jump hosts'
        New-BGInfoTopologyGroup -Id 't0' -Label 'Tier 0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'paw' -Label 'PAW-T0-03' `
            -Subtitle 'Windows 11' -Kind Endpoint -GroupId 'paw'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'jmp' -Label 'JMP-T0-01' `
            -Subtitle 'Server 2025' -Kind Gateway -GroupId 'jump'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'dc1' -Label 'DC01' `
            -Subtitle 'PDC emulator' -Kind Server -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode @node -Id 'ca' -Label 'CA01' `
            -Subtitle 'Enterprise CA' -Kind Certificate -GroupId 't0'
        New-BGInfoTopologyNode -Id 'dc2' -Label 'DC02' -Subtitle 'Replica' `
            -Kind Server -GroupId 't0' -Status Warning
        $link = @{ Kind = 'Connectivity'; Status = 'Healthy' }
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'paw' -TargetNodeId 'jmp' `
            -Label 'RDP + MFA' -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'dc1' `
            -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge @link -SourceNodeId 'jmp' -TargetNodeId 'ca' `
            -Direction Forward
        New-BGInfoTopologyEdge -SourceNodeId 'dc1' -TargetNodeId 'dc2' `
            -Label '14 min lag' -Kind Replication -Status Warning
    }
    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'changes' -Title 'Tier 0 changes' `
        -Kind Area -Values 2, 1, 4, 3, 8, 5, 3, 2, 6, 4 -LineColor $accent `
        -ShowGrid -GridLineCount 3 -ValueSuffix ' this hour' `
        -OffsetX ($hud.MarginX + $half + 24) -OffsetY $hud.MarginY
    New-BGInfoChart @panel @bottom -Id 'alerts' -Title 'Open security alerts' `
        -Kind ProgressBar -Values 1, 3, 6 -Labels 'High', 'Medium', 'Low' `
        -Palette $bad, $warn, $accent -Maximum 10 -NoProgressHandles `
        -ShowLatestValue:$false `
        -OffsetX $hud.MarginX -OffsetY $hud.MarginY
} @text -ConfigurationDirectory $OutputDirectory `
    -OutputFileName "admin-workstation-$($Theme.ToLower()).png"
features: Topology diagram with groups, status and replication
Visual canvas info tiles with mini charts and progress
Bar, area and progress bar charts on shared panels
